At [PyData Paris 2025](https://pretalx.com/pydata-paris-2025/talk/K7CAAE/), September 30, 2025. Three demos on one notebook: publishing it online with `quarto publish`, rendering a print-ready PDF with Typst, and applying an organization's style to HTML and PDF with brand.yml.

[[Slides](https://cderv.dev/pydata-paris-2025-quarto-publish/) · [Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0QIxdDJ8cKE) · [Talk page](https://pretalx.com/pydata-paris-2025/talk/K7CAAE/) · [Code](https://github.com/cderv/pydata-paris-2025-quarto-publish) · [Demo](https://github.com/cderv/demo-ipynb-whr-report)]{.gw-talk-links}
